(17 October)}} |attendance=1,548,515 |average attendance=4,963 | prevseason = [[2009 Torneo Clausura (Chile)|2009–C]] | nextseason = [[2011 Torneo Apertura (Chile)|2011–A]] }} The '''2010 [[Chilean Primera División|Primera División del Fútbol Profesional Chileno]] season''' (known as the '''2010 Campeonato Nacional [[Petrobras]]''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 79th season of top-flight football in [[Chile]]. Originally comprising two [[Apertura and Clausura|tournaments]], the 2010 season was the first single-stage season since 2001. This was due to the devastating 8.8 magnitude [[2010 Chile earthquake|earthquake]] on February 27, 2010. [[Club Deportivo Universidad Católica|Universidad Católica]] won their tenth title. ==Format changes== Due to [[Chile national football team|Chile]]'s qualification to the [[2010 FIFA World Cup]], the format for the season had seen a minor modification in the Apertura, which would not have the playoff stage. The Clausura remained unchanged.{{cite web |url=http://www.anfp.cl/noticia.php?id_noticia=5106 |title=Fixture del Torneo Apertura 2010 |date=December 30, 2009 |publisher=ANFP |language=es |trans-title=2010 Apertura tournament fixture |access-date=January 5, 2010 }} {{Dead link|date=October 2010|bot=H3llBot}} In the wake of the 8.8 magnitude [[2010 Chile earthquake|earthquake]] that struck the country on February 27, the format was further changed to a double round-robin format by the ANFP, because many teams could not fulfill their Apertura fixtures in time as a result of the earthquake damage.{{cite web|url=http://www.anfp.cl/noticia.php?id_noticia=5816 |title=El Campeonato Nacional se jugará a dos ruedas |date=March 8, 2010 |publisher=ANFP |language=es |trans-title=The National Championship will be played in two rounds |access-date=March 8, 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100328075311/http://www.anfp.cl/noticia.php?id_noticia=5816 |archive-date=28 March 2010 |url-status=dead }} After the Round 1 (the first 17 dates), the team with the most points qualified to the [[2010 Copa Sudamericana]] and the [[2011 Copa Libertadores]]. The next best-placed team played a playoff against [[Municipal Iquique]] for the last berth in the [[2010 Copa Sudamericana]]. The season champion (the team with the most points after all 34 dates) also earned a berth to the [[2011 Copa Libertadores]]. The ''Chile 3'' berth for that competition have gone to the winner of a Liguilla of the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, and 5th best-placed teams at the end of the season.{{cite web |url=http://www.anfp.cl/noticia.php?id_noticia=5945 |title=Consejo de clubes definió clasificación a copas |date= March 19, 2010 |publisher=ANFP |language=es |trans-title=Clubs counsel determined qualification to cups |access-date=March 19, 2010 }} {{Dead link|date=October 2010|bot=H3llBot}} ==Teams== {{Location map+ |Chile |float=right |width=225 |caption=Locations of the 2010 Primera División teams |places= {{Location map~ |Chile |lat=-22.460326 |long=-68.920642 |label={{small|[[Cobreloa]]}} |position=right }} {{Location map~ |Chile |lat=-26.251908 |long=-69.628705 |label={{small|[[Cobresal]]}} |position=right }} {{Location map~ |Chile |lat=-33.014354 |long=-71.535237 |label= |position=left }} {{Location map~ |Chile |lat=-33.047778 |long=-71.601111 |label= |position=left }} {{Location map~ |Chile |lat=-36.755156 |long=-73.107690 |label={{small|[[Huachipato]]}} |position=left }} {{Location map~ |Chile |lat=-29.911322 |long=-71.251977 |label={{small|[[Deportes La Serena]]}} |position=left }} {{Location map~ |Chile |lat=-36.618085 |long=-72.107474 |label={{small|[[Ñublense]]}} |position=right }} {{Location map~ |Chile |lat=-34.177844 |long=-70.737497 |label={{small|[[O'Higgins F.C.|O'Higgins]]}} |position=left }} {{Location map~ |Chile |lat=-32.887647 |long=-71.251925 |label= |position=left }} {{Location map~ |Chile |lat=-36.815379 |long=-73.023438 |label={{small|[[C.D. The winner of the Liguilla will qualify to the [[2011 Copa Libertadores]] as ''Chile 3''. The format for the Liguilla was a single elimination tournament, with two legs in each round. The team that finished 2nd in the final league standings played the team that finished 5th, and the team that finished 3rd played the team that finished 4th. The team that finished higher in the standings played the second leg at home. Ties were settled by points (3 for a win, 1 for a draw, 0 for a loss). If there was a tie in point at the end of regulation of the second leg, the team with the best goal difference advances/wins. If a tie remains, the away goals rule is applied, followed by two 15-minute extra-time, and a penalty shootout if necessary. ====First round==== =====Tie 1===== {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |res_col_header=Q |team1=AUD|name_AUD=[[Audax Italiano]] |team2=HUA|name_HUA=[[C.D.
